scope: Physical armor defense only; per-class level-60 R4 anchor. Existing operative class baseline and level contributions included once. No weapons, shield, skills, buffs, affixes, upgrades or gems. Magical defense unchanged and not calibrated by this proposal.

anchor.rule: Per-class divisor = total physical defense at 60 / 60

starterRule.rule: Retain current R1 physical defense as separate starter protection; do not force level-1 total onto the linear curve.
starterRule.reason: Existing R1 is below every proposed R2 total and yields effective armor levels about 8 to 12 at level 1. These values are a starting proposal, not combat-validated.

rounding: Nearest integer set total, largest-remainder allocation 30/26/16/16/12 to five slots
